name: sk-learn for Vector operations (open-source vector library)

mentions.name: sk-learn for Vector operations (open-source vector library)
mentions.description: An open-source library providing vector-related operations such as clustering, classification, and anomaly detection, making it easy for developers to get more out of their vector embeddings — described as 'sk-learn for Vector operations'.
mentions.problem: Vector DBs and embeddings are mostly limited to RAG, so developers lack easy tools for other vector operations.
mentions.source_excerpt: Thinking about making an open-source library specific to Vector related operations like clustering, classification, anomaly detection to make it easy for developers to get more out of their vector embeddings. Basically sk-learn for Vector operations.
mentions.author: Pranav_Ghoghari
